name: lc-vat
description: Saint Lucia VAT registration, standard-rate calculation and return reference checked for 2026. Covers the statutory EC$400,000 registration threshold, forward-looking and three-month tests, standard VAT arithmetic, tourism-rate distinctions and nil-return filing. Use for Saint Lucia VAT, registration deadlines, taxable turnover, standard-rate invoices or tourism accommodation VAT. It uses the Attorney General Chambers revised legislation rather than old government pages retaining the original EC$180,000 threshold. Input recovery, exemptions, levy interaction and current amendments require further checking. This Guide does not claim complete VAT compliance or accountant review.
